text_sections.label: Special Digivolution Condition
text_sections.text: [DNA Digivolve] Red Lv.4 + purple Lv.4: Cost 0

text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Piercing＞ and +4000 DP for the turn. Then, this Digimon may attack. [All Turns] When any of your [Paildramon] or [Dinobeemon] would be deleted, 2 of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into [Imperialdramon: Dragon Mode] in the hand.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
